about: Limits Check Design (crates/openstitch-engine/src/quality.rs) and tools/sew_check.py share, so the app and the tool agree (#866). Edit them here only. maxShortPer1000: the highest rate in all 482 PE-DESIGN 11.50 reference files (compat/reference) is 154.8, its own satin lettering, whose short stitches are at the column turns; 160 sits just above it. minCoverage (#1036): the share of the fabric a plain fill hides, on the coverage curve measured on the T1 sew-outs (tanh(0.4 rows/mm), #291); 0.4 is about 1 row per mm. Of the 364 plain fills in PE-DESIGN's 497 PE-DESIGN 11 references only its own density sweep at 0.1 lines/mm (sweep-fill-density-min, 6 %) is under it; a note in Check Design; sew_check.py reads it too but checks no fills (a stitch file holds no regions).
